title: Labeling retouched images: Effects on the body image of young women in Germany
summary: The planned online study examines how the labeling of edited images affects the body image of young women. Three groups will be compared: the participants will either see retouched images with labeling, retouched images without labeling or unretouched images. They then state how they feel about their own body and mood. The study also examines whether factors such as the ideal of beauty, appreciation of one's own body and comparisons with others influence body image. The connection with the body mass index and media use is also explored.

interventions.name: Unretouched images without labeling: The participants are shown ten unretouched images without labeling.
Retouched images without labeling: The participants are shown ten retouched images without labeling.
Retouched images with labeling: The participants are shown ten retouched images with labeling.
